senses.gloss:
चो(चौ)रः
1 A thief, robber;
सकलं चोर गतं त्वया गृहीतं V. 4. 16;
इंदीवरदलप्रभाचोरं चक्षुः Bh. 3. 67.
--2
Any dishonest dealer.
--3 One that
steals or captivates the heart.
--Comp.
--कर्मन् n. theft.
--गत a. robbed.
--रूपः a clever thief.

चो(चौ)रिका Theft, robbery;
˚विवाह Māl. 1. secret marriage.

1 Theft, robbery.
--2
Trickery.
--3 Secrecy, concealment.
--Comp.
[]
--रतं secret sexual enjoyment;
Pt. 1. 174.
--वृत्तिः f. the habit of robbery.
